description: "The Three Cutters" by Captain Frederick Marryat is a novel written in the mid-19th century. Set against a backdrop of maritime adventures and social satire, the story introduces readers to a mix of naval characters and their interactions aboard various vessels, including a luxurious yacht and revenue cutters.
